How shopify sellers can find their meta to Amazon spillover #amazon #shopify #metaads #amazonfba #tiktokads
I think it's so funny every time I talk to a Shopify seller who has no idea how much spillover from their meta ads is going over to Amazon. And it's actually so easy to find, it's kind of crazy. All you need to do is you need to go to the Amazon search results, and as long as you have a tool called Helium 10 or one of the other tools that give you search volume, you can just immediately type in the competitor's brand name and look to see how much search volume was there. The other thing you can do if you don't have Helium 10, it's just go into your actual Amazon account and go look at the search query performance report, and it tells you how much branded search is gonna be there. And it is insane how much spillover there is from one platform to another.

How shopify sellers can find their meta to Amazon spillover #amazon #shopify #metaads #amazonfba #tiktokads
I think it's so funny every time I talk to a Shopify seller who has no idea how much spillover from their meta ads is going over to Amazon. And it's actually so easy to find, it's kind of crazy. All you need to do is you need to go to the Amazon search results, and as long as you have a tool called Helium 10 or one of the other tools that give you search volume, you can just immediately type in the competitor's brand name and look to see how much search volume was there. The other thing you can do if you don't have Helium 10, it's just go into your actual Amazon account and go look at the search query performance report, and it tells you how much branded search is gonna be there. And it is insane how much spillover there is from one platform to another.
